description: Example MFE chat input that submits prompt over GraphQL mutation and receives response over GraphQL stream subscription.

props_schema.title: Chat Module Props
props_schema.description: Configuration for the Example Chat MFE runtime and GraphQL transport.

title.title: Title
title.description: Header text shown at the top of the chat module.

inputPlaceholder.title: Input Placeholder
inputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text shown inside the prompt input.

submitLabel.title: Submit Label
submitLabel.description: Button label used to submit a prompt.

assistantLabel.title: Assistant Label
assistantLabel.description: Display name used for assistant response messages.

maxMessages.title: Max Messages
maxMessages.description: Maximum number of chat lines retained in the visible message list.

requestCommand.title: Request Command
requestCommand.description: Command name the host uses to invoke this chat module programmatically.

graphql.title: GraphQL Transport
graphql.description: GraphQL mutation + streaming subscription settings used by this module.

httpUrl.title: GraphQL HTTP URL
httpUrl.description: HTTP endpoint used for GraphQL mutation requests.

wsUrl.title: GraphQL WS URL
wsUrl.description: WebSocket endpoint used for GraphQL stream subscriptions.

authToken.title: Auth Token
authToken.description: Optional bearer token override for GraphQL HTTP and WS calls. Leave empty to inherit shell auth.

hasuraRole.title: Hasura Role
hasuraRole.description: Deprecated for async mode. This module does not send X-Hasura-Role and uses the token-derived default role.

tokenExchange.title: Token Exchange
tokenExchange.description: Optional OAuth token exchange for converting the shell access token to the audience needed by this MFE.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: When true, exchange the current bearer token before GraphQL submit/stream calls.

requestedAudience.title: Requested Audience
requestedAudience.description: Target audience for exchanged token (for example Hasura audience/client id).

requestedAudiences.title: Requested Audiences
requestedAudiences.description: Optional list of target audiences. Use when a single exchanged token must include multiple aud values.

requestedScope.title: Requested Scope
requestedScope.description: Optional scope requested during token exchange.

exchangeUrl.title: Gateway Exchange URL
exchangeUrl.description: Dedicated backend token exchange endpoint (for example auth-gateway /v1/auth/token-exchange). When set, token exchange is performed through this backend.

appSlug.title: Gateway App Slug
appSlug.description: Registered auth-gateway app slug used by the backend token exchange endpoint.

tokenUrl.title: Token Endpoint URL
tokenUrl.description: OIDC token endpoint used for token exchange. Leave empty to use shell auth runtime defaults.

clientId.title: Client Id
clientId.description: OIDC client id used for token exchange. Leave empty to use shell auth runtime defaults.

submitMutation.title: Submit Mutation
submitMutation.description: GraphQL mutation document used to submit async requests.

submitVariables.title: Submit Variables Template
submitVariables.description: JSON template for submit mutation variables. Supports placeholders like {{prompt}} and {{requestId}}.

submitRequestIdPath.title: Submit Request Id Path
submitRequestIdPath.description: Dot-path to extract request id from the mutation response payload.

streamSubscription.title: Stream Subscription
streamSubscription.description: GraphQL subscription document used to stream async response updates.

streamVariables.title: Stream Variables Template
streamVariables.description: JSON template for stream subscription variables.

streamTextPath.title: Stream Text Path
streamTextPath.description: Dot-path to read streamed assistant text from subscription payloads.

streamDonePath.title: Stream Done Path
streamDonePath.description: Dot-path to read completion status from subscription payloads.

streamErrorPath.title: Stream Error Path
streamErrorPath.description: Dot-path to read error text from subscription payloads.

streamChunkMode.title: Stream Chunk Mode
streamChunkMode.description: How incoming stream text is applied to the assistant response.

conversationId.title: Conversation Id
conversationId.description: Optional fixed conversation identifier passed through submit/stream templates.

async.title: Async Config
async.description: Host runtime async behavior for request/retry/stream/queue processing.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable async mode handling for this module instance.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Async operation mode used by the host runtime.

request.title: Request Policy
request.description: Request timeout and retry policy for outbound async requests.

defaultTimeoutMs.title: Default Timeout (ms)
defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default request timeout used by the runtime.

maxAttempts.title: Max Attempts
maxAttempts.description: Maximum retry attempts after the initial request.

initialBackoffMs.title: Initial Backoff (ms)
initialBackoffMs.description: Initial wait time before the first retry.

maxBackoffMs.title: Max Backoff (ms)
maxBackoffMs.description: Upper bound for exponential retry backoff.

jitter.title: Jitter
jitter.description: Enable randomized jitter to reduce retry stampedes.

stream.title: Stream Policy
stream.description: Streaming transport settings for async response delivery.

endpointRef.title: Endpoint Ref
endpointRef.description: Named endpoint alias used by the host runtime.

authMode.title: Auth Mode
authMode.description: Authentication mode for stream transport connections.

reconnect.title: Reconnect Policy
reconnect.description: Retry/backoff policy for stream reconnect attempts.

maxAttempts.title: Max Attempts
maxAttempts.description: Maximum reconnect attempts before giving up.

queue.title: Queue Policy
queue.description: In-memory queue controls for inflight async work.

maxInflight.title: Max Inflight
maxInflight.description: Maximum number of inflight async operations.

dropPolicy.title: Drop Policy
dropPolicy.description: Policy used when queue capacity is exceeded.

orderingKey.title: Ordering Key
orderingKey.description: Key used to preserve per-entity ordering for queued operations.

requestChannel.title: Request Channel
requestChannel.description: Optional request topic/channel identifier passed into submit templates and events.

responseChannel.title: Response Channel
responseChannel.description: Optional response topic/channel identifier passed into stream templates and events.

correlationIdPath.title: Correlation Id Path
correlationIdPath.description: Fallback dot-path used to resolve request id when extracting async correlation values.

ui.title: UI Configuration
ui.description: Optional UI-level configuration for this module.
